_comment: Scope rules and role split for experiments/procurement/build_pool.py. category_whitelist: 標的分類 code prefixes as strings ("452" = that code only, "45" = every code under 45); empty = all goods categories. amount_tiers: allowed 採購金額級距 values; empty = any. budget_min / budget_max: inclusive NT$ bounds on 預算金額, null = open (150,000 = central-government small-purchase ceiling, 1,500,000 = announcement threshold since 2023-01-01; whether to include the endpoints is pending). coding_sheet: the manual coding sheet (export_coding_sheet.py, codes in coding_manual.md); include = N excludes a case; require_coding: refuse to build while an in-scope case is uncoded (set true when freezing). assignment: "blocked" = implicit stratification by 2-digit category group and budget (see build_pool.py), "sequential" = pool_rank order. roles: the wording-robustness block reuses the stage1_2 cases, so it has no role of its own; H3 has no role at freezing either: it uses the unassigned (pool) cases plus expansion batches drawn after freezing (h1_decision_record.md A9, A10). exclude_case_ids: cases already played in exploratory pilots or smoke tests; they are never given a role. Freezing: set frozen to true, run build_pool, then fetch_awards manifest; from then on build_pool refuses to run if this file differs from the hash in MANIFEST.json.
